title: VTC Elections — Certify — payload
description: An administrator has the community verify a tallied election's board for itself and certify its result. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

items.description: A verifiable credential, as its auditor issued it, attesting the auditor's own recount of this election's board (VTI-VOT-073). Kept exactly as received.

auditAttestations.description: Attestations from auditors the manifest names in `board.auditors`, to be certified with the result.

Response.title: VTC Elections — Certify — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/elections/certify/0.1: the result the community verified and certified.

result.description: The result the community recomputed from the board, equal to the ballot box's.

head.description: The board head the community verified: the head as it stood at close, which the result counts exactly.

items.description: An auditor's attestation the community verified, as received.

auditAttestations.description: The attestations certified with the result; empty when none was given.
